# Behavioral and values

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/behavioral-values.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Your real stories, motivation and judgement: ownership, conflict, mistakes, and why this company.

## Both tracks

- **Why do you want to work at Anthropic, and where do you disagree with its approach?**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether motivation is informed and leaves room for independent judgement.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Connect specific public work or mission choices to your own professional interests.
    - Offer a reasoned disagreement and state what evidence could change your view.
    - Explain how you would contribute while engaging constructively with that disagreement.
  - Read: [Careers](https://www.anthropic.com/careers) (Anthropic)
- **Describe a mistake you made, its consequences and what you changed afterward.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you take responsibility and show learning through concrete behaviour.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe your decision and what you knew at the time.
    - Explain impact, recovery and your responsibility without blaming others.
    - Identify a lasting change and evidence that it helped.
  - Read: [Postmortem Culture: Learning from Failure](https://sre.google/sre-book/postmortem-culture/) (Google)
- **Tell me about a time you disagreed with someone and could not persuade them.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you work constructively after losing an argument.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - State both positions fairly and explain your evidence.
    - Describe the decision process and how you supported the agreed action.
    - Explain the result, limits of commitment and what you learned.
  - Read: [Leadership Principles](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles) (Amazon Jobs)
- **Describe a time when work created a moral conflict for you. What did you do?**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you can explain values, consequences and practical action without a rehearsed slogan.
- **What do you see as the significant risks of advanced AI systems?**
  - Knowledge · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you articulate a coherent, evidence-sensitive view of AI risk.
- **Which project are you most proud of, and why?**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you explain meaningful impact and your actual contribution.
- **Describe a conflict with a colleague, how you handled it and what you learned.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you understand the other person's perspective and your own part in the conflict.
- **Describe a disagreement with a researcher or technical lead about priorities and what followed.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can reason across research and engineering incentives.
- **Describe a project that used data and machine learning. What obstacles did you encounter?**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you connect technical obstacles to actions and delivered outcomes.
- **Tell me about achieving a meaningful result despite substantial ambiguity.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you reduce uncertainty through decisions and feedback.
- **Describe a technical decision you championed that turned out to be wrong.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can reverse a position and repair its consequences.
- **Tell me about an opportunity you saw that was larger than the original scope of your assignment.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you recognise broader value and justify taking on additional scope.
- **Describe a time when you had to make progress without access to the full context.**
  - Behavioral · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish safe assumptions from decisions that require clarification.
- **What is the most technically demanding thing you have shipped, and what would you do differently now?**
  - Self-presentation · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you explain complexity and lessons beyond the prestige of the technology.
- **Describe one model you shipped that improved a business outcome and another that did not.**
  - Behavioral · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish deployment from realised value and can explain the difference.
- **Tell me about a short-term sacrifice you made to achieve a longer-term benefit.**
  - Behavioral · Senior
  - Tests: Whether you can justify delayed value and assess whether it materialised.
- **Describe a time you pushed back on a customer's request.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you protect the customer's underlying goal while challenging a proposed solution.
- **How do you think about work for defence or intelligence customers, and what would you do if a requested project conflicted with your values?**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you reason about concrete boundaries and professional responsibility.
- **Describe feedback that was difficult for you to hear and what you did with it.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can respond to criticism with specific learning and action.

## AI Leadership

- **Tell me about conflicting stakeholder priorities and how you established alignment.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you make competing objectives explicit and build an actionable agreement.
- **Tell me about an AI decision you owned that had significant downstream consequences.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you consider impact beyond your immediate deliverable.
- **How do you manage conflict when the situation is urgent?**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether urgency changes the decision process without eliminating respect and accountability.
- **What is the largest failure you have experienced as a product manager?**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you can discuss product judgement, consequences and changed practice honestly.
